title: Conference centre built from large components prefabricated overseas (consent refused)
jurisdiction: New Zealand (MBIE Chief Executive determination; Building Act 2004; comparative only, not Alberta)

facts.text: The owner proposes a conference centre at an existing holiday park: three separate modules, each opening onto an interconnecting timber deck; total floor area including decking is about 195 m2.

The application received on 9 April 2018 described the scope as foundation only and was accompanied by location and site plans, elevations, phase drawings, floor framing and foundation plans, and pile and stair details.
Figure 1 is the floor plan of the proposed conference centre (not to scale).
The determination addresses what is and is not building work for components prefabricated offshore, and the authority's ability to assess them.
